Specimens 45987-94/19 show breast tissue with areas suspicious for unspecified carcinoma G1 (1+2+1=4 according to NGS) with a largest dimension of 6mm. Breast tissue with foci of stromal fibrosis. 52041-3B-1, 52041-4B-1. Breast tissue with stromal fibrosis and numerous cystically dilated ducts. Some ducts show columnar epithelial proliferation with hyperchromatic nuclei, and some show solid epithelial proliferation consisting of relatively monomorphic cells with round nuclei. Immunohistochemical staining was performed to confirm the presence of myoepithelium – a layer of myoepithelium with expression of Cytokeratin 14, Calponin-1 (EP798Y) (Calp-1 (EP798Y)) surrounds the foci of adenosis; however, the expression of CK14 is absent in the epithelial cells of the ducts with solid proliferation. In some ducts, there are calcifications. The nuclei of the epithelium in the proliferation zone show pronounced diffuse expression of ER (6F11). Expression of CK14 is absent around areas suspicious for invasion, confirming the presence of carcinoma. Weak ER expression (2+1=3 according to Allred) was detected in the atypical glands. Diagnostic material in the block was exhausted during Calponin staining.

diff_diagnostic: Due to the specific morphological characteristics of the tumor (well-defined node with a predominantly solid, as well as cribriform growth pattern from tumor cells with mild to moderate nuclear pleomorphism with low mitotic activity, with inconspicuous fibrovacular stalks), solid papillary carcinoma with an invasive component cannot be excluded. Therefore, immunohistochemical testing (2 antibodies: Synaptophysin, Chromogranin A) is recommended. Staging of the tumor according to TNM is also difficult due to the difficulty in objectively assessing the extent of the invasive component; therefore, immunohistochemical testing on 4 blocks (8 antibodies: Calponin (2), CK14 (2)) is recommended. Evaluation of resection margins is difficult because in the primary material of sector resection, the stained margin partially runs through tumor elements. Furthermore, in the additionally submitted lateral margins, the true surgical margin is not marked, and in areas of coagulation and areas stained with dye, foci suspicious for tumor growth are identified - to objectify this, immunohistochemical testing on 3 blocks (6 antibodies: Calponin (3), CK14 (3)) is recommended. Considering the uncertainty in the extent of the invasive component of the carcinoma, assessment of the surrogate molecular-genetic subtype is recommended after clarification of the size of the invasive carcinoma based on immunohistochemical study results.
